panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: vlpds_build_info: node id, git revision (`-dirty` = uncommitted changes), profiling feature

panels.title: Write request latency (createRecord/putRecord/deleteRecord/applyWrites)
panels.description: Server-side XRPC latency, from the vlpds_http_request_duration_seconds histogram (0.1 ms .. 52 s, x2 buckets)

panels.title: Commit latency: enqueue -> durable + applied + acked
Coalescing
panels.description: Means over the rate window: write requests per commit, ops per commit, firehose events per segment, worker messages per loop

panels.title: Mean time per stage (per segment)
panels.description: seal_wait: oldest entry's enqueue -> PUT start; put: PUT until durable (hedges/retries incl.); apply_lock: finalizer waiting for the shards' apply locks; apply: SlateDB batches; ack: acks + repo views. Stacked means approximate the commit latency of a segment's oldest entry.

panels.title: PUT attempts by result, hedges
panels.description: already_exists = a conditional-PUT conflict (our own hedge winning, or a fence)

panels.title: Events emitted / frames sent per s
Repo lookups by result
panels.description: hit: cached; miss: starts a cold load; loading: joins a load in flight

panels.title: Cold loads by result, evictions
panels.description: stale = a load finished after its shard moved (dropped, reloaded)

panels.title: M/ bytes prefetched per cold open
Connections
panels.description: Outbound connects should stay flat under steady load (pooled h2c to peers)

panels.title: Other vlpds_http_* metrics
panels.description: Catch-all for HTTP metrics added later (raw values: counters climb)

panels.title: Forwards/s by owner status
panels.description: 5xx includes owner unreachable / past its TTFB deadline (503 PartitionUnavailable)

panels.title: Lease renewal round trip
panels.description: One CAS PUT of nodes/{node_id} every TTL/5. Validity ends TTL - skew after a renewal's send time, so a round trip over 0.4 x TTL (4 s at the default 10 s TTL) lapses the lease and the node fail-stops (exit 5). The ceiling line assumes the default TTL.

panels.title: Lease validity left
panels.description: Seconds until each node's own lease validity ends, computed at scrape: normally TTL - skew minus up to one renew interval (6-8 s by default); a sawtooth dipping toward 0 = renewals overdue

panels.title: Renew errors, takeovers, fail-stops
panels.description: takeover peer: a dead peer's log fenced before taking its shards; restart: our own previous incarnation's at startup. vlpds_last_exit_reason_info on a restarted node says why its previous process ended.

panels.title: Shard opens by kind (time to serve)
panels.description: replay: the batch replayed a dead owner's log tail (takeover after a crash); clean: nothing to replay (handback)

panels.title: Shards opened / segments replayed per s

panels.description: Non-ok results: not_found / precondition are normal answers (misses, lost CAS races); timeout / error failed; cancelled = the caller gave up
